sources.name: Unicode Unihan 17.0.0: modern Mandarin readings and frequency counts
sources.author: Unicode, Inc.; Unihan contributors; kHanyuPinlu digitization and proofing by Richard Cook with contributors documented in UAX #38
modifications: Extract only kMandarin, kTGHZ2013 and kHanyuPinlu from the pinned archive.
Preserve kMandarin source order; append distinct kTGHZ2013 modern readings; retain field provenance per reading.
Normalize readings to Unicode NFC; retain tone marks and neutral tone spelling; do not infer pronunciation from context.
Sum kHanyuPinlu pronunciation counts per character; keep missing frequency absent rather than zero.
Exclude kHanyuPinyin and kXHC1983 to avoid silently accepting historical or rare dictionary readings as modern defaults.
Do not deduplicate simplified and traditional counts or compute corpus coverage percentages from this derivative.
sources.notes: A pinned historical Unicode release is intentional; this is not a claim to include the newest Unicode release. kHanyuPinlu uses the 1986 frequency dictionary's 1,807,389-ideograph corpus across four genres, with duplicated counts possible for simplified/traditional forms. It is not a current Internet ranking.

sources.name: Zhuluo shuangpin-practice: Xiaohe initial, final and zero-initial mapping
sources.author: sharebravery (许多言); Xiaohe layout designed by 何海峰（散步的鹤）
modifications: Extract only the xiaohe initials, finals and zeroInitials objects into JSON; no upstream TypeScript is executed.
Preserve upstream lowercase key values and v/ve spellings for ü/üe.
Exclude other layouts, all upstream practice text and all application code.
sources.notes: Upstream THIRD_PARTY.md states the scheme rules were independently organized from public layout rules and no third-party application source was copied. Official Flypy images were inspected for verification only; no official images are redistributed.
